visualCharacteristics.purpose: Social share links for the current page
visualCharacteristics.layout: 'Share' label followed by three 40px circular icon links: LinkedIn, Facebook, X

contentPattern.structure: Auto-built inside the article-header on blog-article pages. When authored: an empty block, or a single cell whose text replaces the 'Share' label
contentPattern.behavior: Links are built from the canonical URL (else page URL without query/hash) and og:title / H1; each opens in a new tab with rel='noopener noreferrer' and an aria-label 'Share on <network> (opens in a new tab)'; the list is labelled by the visible label

notes: Auto-blocked in the article header of all blog-article stories

reuseGuidance: Comes for free on blog articles. Elsewhere, author an empty 'Share' block where the links should appear.
